items.title: How worried should software, semiconductor stocks be about AI risks?
items.summary: SK hynix (SKHY) is reportedly in talks with Intel (INTC) to use the latter's facilities to manufacture memory chips in the US for the first time, according to Reuters. Yahoo Finance's Jake Conley and Pras Subramanian are joined by RBC Capital Markets head of derivatives strategy Amy Wu Silverman to examine how the software industry is reacting to AI headlines, comparing it to the internet booms of the past.

items.title: Why human emotion is the biggest threat to your portfolio
items.summary: New Age Alpha Chief Investment Officer Julian Koski and Bullseye American Ingenuity Fund Portfolio Manager Adam Johnson discuss why the underlying economy is much stronger than the headlines suggest.

items.title: AI will not wipe out humanity, Nvidia-backed tech CEO declares
items.summary: It's somewhat reassuring to see prominent names in tech pushing back on the notion AI will wipe out the human race.

items.title: Salesforce and Google Service Outages Strike on Day 2 of Dreamforce Conference
items.summary: Salesforce users ‘may experience severe delays, intermittent errors, or an inability to access some services,’ the company says.

items.title: What Happens To Microsoft Stock If Its AI Spending Keeps Climbing?
items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) is reported to be planning about 38 gigawatts of data center capacity by 2032, more than triple what it runs today. Its capital spending has already climbed sharply over the past twelve months, and management said in July that it expects fiscal 2027 spending to grow again. So what happens to the stock if the spending simply keeps climbing.

items.title: Salesforce, Intel, Dell, J.B. Hunt, Expedia, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Stocks rose on Wednesday as investors waited for the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision.   Intel gained 5.7% and SK Hynix added 2.2% after Reuters reported the two companies had discussed a potential memory-chip partnership.

items.title: Why Nvidia Stock Is Rising as Meta’s Zuckerberg Weighs In on AI Safety
items.summary: Nvidia stock is at risk if companies pause AI development. CEO Jensen Huang is determined to make sure that doesn't happen.

items.title: HUBS Benefits From Strong Cash Flow Growth: Will the Momentum Last?
items.summary: HubSpot is boosting cash flow as revenues, margins and AI adoption grow, but competition and valuation raise questions about momentum.
